title: Breaker
description: Clear the neon wall. Move with arrows or A/D; space serves. Angle the ball with the edge of your paddle. Three lives.

rules.do: repeat (35) { spawn('brick', {x: 54 + (i % 7) * 62, y: 60 + floor(i / 7) * 25, fill: ['#ff5d73','#ff9f43','#ffcf5a','#7ee081','#7df9ff'][floor(i / 7)], tags: ['brick']}) }

do: if (self.data.ready) { self.x = p.x; self.y = 311; if (pressed('fire')) { self.data.ready = false; self.vx = 125; self.vy = -220 } }
if (self.x < 6) { self.x = 6; self.vx = abs(self.vx) }; if (self.x > W - 6) { self.x = W - 6; self.vx = -abs(self.vx) }; if (self.y < 30) { self.y = 30; self.vy = abs(self.vy) }
if (self.vy > 0 && self.y >= 314 && self.y <= 330 && abs(self.x - p.x) < 41) { self.y = 313; self.vx = (self.x - p.x) * 6; self.vy = -max(180, 270 - abs(self.vx) * 0.25); sound('hit') }
if (self.y > H + 8) { state.lives -= 1; self.vx = 0; self.vy = 0; self.data.ready = true; sound('lose'); if (state.lives <= 0) state.over = true }

rules.do: if (alive(b)) { despawn(b); a.y = a.vy < 0 ? b.y + 14 : b.y - 14; a.vy = -a.vy; state.score += 10; sound('hit') }

if (!state.over && state.scene == 'play' && count('brick') == 0 && frame > 1) { state.over = true; get('ball').vx = 0; get('ball').vy = 0; spawn(null, {text: 'WALL CLEARED', size: 26, x: 240, y: 180, stroke: '#7ee081', width: 2}) }
let t = get('info'); if (t) t.text = 'LIVES ' + str(state.lives) + '   SPACE SERVES   ARROWS MOVE'
